skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze unemployment issues in a market economy and understand the role of unemployment insurance.
Apply knowledge of labor laws to support unemployed workers and understand the necessity of unemployment insurance in Vietnam.
Understand and apply the legal framework of unemployment insurance in Vietnam.
Compare unemployment insurance systems in different countries and derive lessons for Vietnam.
Evaluate and implement policies related to unemployment insurance.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve unemployment-related problems systematically.
Conduct research and write reports on unemployment insurance policies and practices.
Present findings and research results effectively.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and discussions.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and participate in seminars.
